story.title: Connecting Global Buyers with Vietnamese Industrial Manufacturing & Export Excellence.
story.body: The Vietnam Trade Promotion Agency (VIETRADE) is the governmental agency operating under the Ministry of Industry and Trade of Vietnam (MOIT) responsible for state management, national trade promotion, export acceleration, and the Vietnam National Brand program. Leading the Vietnamese commercial presence at Trade Expo Indonesia (TEI 2026), VIETRADE connects international buyers, importers, and regional distribution partners directly with accredited Vietnamese enterprises across agriculture, specialty coffee, consumer goods, renewable materials, and industrial supply chains.

highlights.title: Bilateral Trade & Sourcing Delegations
highlights.body: Facilitating structured B2B matchmaking, trade missions, and high-trust procurement channels between international buyers and certified Vietnamese manufacturers.

highlights.title: Vietnam National Brand (Vietnam Value)
highlights.body: Overseeing the national brand development program, certifying premier enterprises that champion quality, innovation, and sustainable export standards.

highlights.title: Trade Fairs & Global Exhibitions
highlights.body: Organizing Vietnam's signature international trade exhibitions—including Vietnam Expo and Vietnam Foodexpo—and coordinating official overseas trade pavilions.

highlights.title: Export Intelligence & Market Facilitation
highlights.body: Providing international partners with authoritative regulatory trade policies, tariff guidance, tariff-free trade frameworks, and direct enterprise linkage.
